products.title: Handcrafted Kinhal Ganesha Figurine
products.description: Handcrafted authentic Kinhal Woodcraft by traditional master makers.
products.story: My name is Anand Gudigar from Koppal, Karnataka. I learned the nuances of Kinhal Woodcraft from my father, carrying forward our 4th-generation Chitragar lineage. What makes this Handcrafted Kinhal Ganesha Figurine distinct is that it is hand-chiseled from seasoned Ponki softwood, sealed with traditional tamarind-seed paste (Kitta), and hand-painted with traditional iconography. Creating this piece requires 18 hours of detailed wood chiseling, natural paste layering, and fine brush embossing. When you bring this piece into your home, you support our craft legacy directly.
